newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Siam Commercial MTN programme.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Siam Commercial MTN programme.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp on Thursday said it had assigned a BBB-plus long-term and A-2 short-term counterparty rating to the senior obligations of Siam Commercial Bank Public Co Ltd's US$1.5 billion global medium term note programme.
S&P also assigned a BBB long-term rating to the dated subordinated debt under the programme. It said the rating outlook was negative.

S&P said the senior ratings of Siam Commercial were downgraded on March 18, 1997, reflecting an anticipated rise in non-performing loans as a result of the deterioration in Thailand's financial sector following the downturn in the property market and slowdown in the economy.
The negative outlook on Siam Commercial reflects S&P's concerns that the economic downturn and resulting asset-quality problems will be higher and more prolonged than anticipated.
Despite these concerns, S&P said the bank's ratings remained underpinned by several favourable features, including the bank's sound market position and its partial ownership by Crown Property Bureau.

S&P also said that Siam Commercial's profitability and capitalisation are above-average, in an international context, enabling additional flexibility to manage a higher level of non-performing loans over the near-to-medium term.
